svg.aria-label: Three stages of sexual reproduction (conjugation) in the bread mould Rhizopus. Top left: two hyphae, one marked minus and one plus, arch towards each other and their swollen tips, each with nuclei, meet. Top right: the tips have been cut off as two gametangia, labelled Gametangia, pressed together between the curved minus and plus hyphae. Bottom: the gametangia have fused into one large, dark, round body with a thick, rough, warty wall, labelled I, held between the two hyphae
